issues.observed: Actual DOS Defender boot failed before frames with WebAssembly.Module refusing script-src self.
issues.cause: The server HTTP CSP was stricter than the child meta policy.
issues.fix: The DOS child route received its own wasm-unsafe-eval CSP header, preserving same-origin framing and the main application policy.
issues.verification: All three actual DOS titles subsequently booted, with no page errors.

issues.observed: The fresh first 120 ms desktop/mobile press highlighted Start but did not activate it. A 1000 ms fresh first touch also failed. A temporary 50000-cycle test and 350 ms minimum press alone did not fix the behavior.
issues.cause: The native GUI required time to process mouse motion before the button-down edge.
issues.fix: Master Mind input sends motion and neutral button-up, waits 150 ms, then sends a native down with a 350 ms minimum pulse. Physical short taps complete the queued native click; lifecycle cancellation is separately regression tested.
issues.verification: Fresh first 120 ms desktop click and mobile touch succeeded, followed by four-pin guesses and feedback using only 120 ms inputs.
